name: B10-0392/2025 (Renew) – Case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Rwandan opposition leader Victoire Ingabire, held since June 2025 on charges she denies. It says her trial is unfair and that her party is blocked from elections. It asks Rwanda to free her and others held for peaceful activism, register her party, and investigate deaths and disappearances of opposition figures. It also asks the European Union to tie its cooperation with Rwanda to human rights and to seek visits to detainees.

- Nothing changes yet: the Parliament is stating demands, not making law.
- Rwanda's government, courts and Victoire Ingabire are directly affected.
- The European Union is asked to link aid and cooperation to human rights.
